description: Exactly one entry per BSI Edition-2023 Anforderung supplied in the request chunk, in the same order.

bsi_control_id.description: The exact ID of the BSI ED2023 Anforderung from the request chunk, copied verbatim (e.g. 'ORP.1.A1').

matched_gpp_control_id.description: The ID of the single best-matching G++ control, copied verbatim from the provided G++ list (e.g. 'GC.5.2'). Empty string if no G++ control is a reasonable match.

begruendung.description: Short justification (German) why this G++ control is the best match, or why none matches.
